description:
You are a private pilot using the Avare EFB (Electronic Flight Bag) to plan a VFR cross-country flight from the San Francisco Bay Area to Las Vegas. Professional VFR pilots do not fly direct airport-to-airport over mountain terrain; they use intermediate VOR radio navigation fixes to stay on airways and clear obstructions.

Your task: build a complete VFR flight plan with KSFO (San Francisco International) as departure and KLAS (Las Vegas) as destination, including at least 3 intermediate navaids or airports along the route for a total minimum of 5 waypoints. The chart must remain on VFR Sectional display. When the plan is fully built, save it so it persists.
